title: The inbox filename timestamp layout is written as two bare literals (the reader in inboxbatch.FiledAt, the writer in ciwatch)
summary: F40 architecture review m5 / re-review MINOR 4: inboxbatch/item.go filenameStampLayout ("2006-01-02T15-04-05Z") parses the stamp that ciwatch/ciwatch.go writes with its own literal. A respelling on either side silently turns FiledAt's filename fallback into zero (no drift evidence). Also: FiledAt's fallback depends on Item.Path, which only LoadFile sets — decoders that unmarshal records directly get a different answer.
fix: Export ONE layout constant (or a StampFilename/ParseFilenameStamp pair) from inboxbatch and use it in ciwatch; when the planner starts using FiledAt, pass the path explicitly.
acceptance: Exactly one non-test declaration of the filename-stamp layout; ciwatch writes through it (a single-declaration pin)
